items.title: Christa Pike discharged from hospital and returned to prison, her lawyers say
items.description: The convicted murderer was left in a critical condition after she survived two lethal injections.

items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
items.description: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
items.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

items.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
items.description: The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - want electoral reforms ahead of crucial state elections.

items.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
items.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

items.title: Saudi capital airport hit again, sparking evacuations, reports say
items.description: The suspected attack comes a day after Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed two deadly attacks on the Riyadh airport.

items.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
items.description: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".
